descriptionChirho: Proper feminine name רִבְקָה (Rivqah/Rebekah), wife of Isaac and mother of Esau and Jacob, prominent in the patriarchal narratives of Genesis 22-49 and referenced in Ruth 4. The two clusters differ only by the presence of the conjunction waw ('and Rebekah' vs. 'Rebekah'). Eng 'Rebekah / and Rebekah,' Spa 'Rivqah / Y Rivqah,' Hin 'रिबका / और रिबका,' Arb 'رِفْقَةَ / وَرِفقَةُ,' Kor '리브가가 / 그리고 리브가가,' Swa 'Rebeka / Na Rebeka.' No semantic distinction; conjunction is purely syntactic.
